A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VeBNN research work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and appendices A–F are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original regression experiments, plasticity simulations, uncertainty evaluations and ablations in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, simulation-based evaluations and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 changes final iteration selection from argmax over i to argmax over i>1, excluding the first iterate as written. The mean–variance–BNN training sequence, Gamma objective and inference methods remain unchanged. The PDFs do not explain whether the selection restriction is intentional.

E1.justification: Both versions retain UCI regression, image regression and distribution-shift scenarios, APPA-REAL, plasticity sequences, and synthetic homoscedastic, heteroscedastic and multimodal examples. Chair becoming ChairAngle standardizes the name of an existing dataset.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged within the corresponding experiments, including the natural-reparameterized ensemble comparisons in Figure 19. Tables 6–8 merely standardize existing labels such as MC-Dropout to MVE (MC-Dropout) and End-to-end (pSGLD) to MVE (pSGLD).

E3.justification: Appendix C revises two reported metric definitions. Equation (45) changes RNN error aggregation from per-time-step relative norms to per-output relative norms over time; Equation (48) replaces variance differences with standard-deviation differences. Splits and training budgets are retained. These revisions do not establish that results were recomputed.

E4.justification: The loss, iteration-count and variance-network-size ablations, calibration analyses, and noise/distribution-shift tests are retained. Figure 6 corrects the display of the existing illustrative case without introducing a new analysis or test.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same repeated-run and seed information, standard-deviation reporting, plotted error bars and Wilcoxon significance-testing practices. No additional runs or new statistical estimation procedures are reported.

E6.justification: Figure 6 corrects the displayed aleatoric interval in the separate variance-training panel, particularly outside the training region, bringing it into agreement with the existing Step-2 illustration in Figure 1. Benchmark table values and other performance curves remain unchanged; the revised metric formulas do not establish a performance gain.

T1.justification: The central theoretical justification is substantially revised. Appendix A.2.2 adds a proof that the single-point MVE output-space loss has no finite critical point. Appendix A.3 replaces the unconditional squared-bias argument with a conditional squared-deviation derivation using independent fresh observation noise. Equations (27) and (29) and the mathematical metric definitions in Appendix C also receive substantive corrections.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution summary and conclusion retain the same claims about cooperative training, uncertainty disentanglement, improved mean estimation, scalability and architectural applicability. The new theoretical material supports the existing contribution rather than redefining it.

C2.justification: UCI coverage is now interpreted as evidence of calibrated intervals rather than absence of distribution shift. The APPA-REAL discussion acknowledges coverage far below 0.95, consistent with Table 3. Appendix A.3 explicitly states that general bias reduction and monotonic improvement are not proved, while A.2 strengthens its explanation of degenerate optimization behavior.

D1.justification: Appendices E–F retain the implementation settings, hardware, simulation procedures and data-availability information. The existing code link moves from a methodology footnote to the abstract; this does not change resource availability or access instructions.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and research positioning are retained. The Shukla et al. reference gains a URL, but that work and its discussion were already present in v2.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized paragraph revisions, standardizes heading capitalization and terminology, corrects typos and relocates the code link. The section order and overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is redrawn with a corrected uncertainty envelope; Figure 2 removes the fixed beta value from its legend. Some table labels are standardized, Figure 26's caption changes first column to first row, and added text causes local reflow. The overall figure/table organization is retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves mathematical accuracy through the conditional bias derivation and equation corrections, and more candidly qualifies convergence and APPA-REAL coverage. These support a limited net gain. New inconsistencies constrain that improvement: Algorithm 1 excludes iteration 1 despite retained K=1 experiments, and Appendix A.2 calls the Hessian everywhere indefinite despite its stated zero-residual exception.
